title: Metric
description: A Tier 1 measure over entities, carrying variants. Tier 2 metrics have no file of their own: they are `components` of a Tier 1 parent or entries in a family index. See ADR-0001 and src/metrics/README.md.

else.description: A draft metric is a deliberately incomplete branch open to contribution; it carries identity and a definition. Anything else must have the full Tier 1 treatment.

tier.description: Only Tier 1 metrics get a file. Promoting a Tier 2 metric needs an ADR.

preferred_label.description: Where label_decided_by is set, this must equal the label that decision's default option gives this metric (validator), so the file shows the market-default name.

label_decided_by.description: A decision that sets the display label via its options' `labels`. Validator: that decision gates this metric with `affects: preferred_label`, and preferred_label equals its default option's label.

aliases.description: Every name the metric is known by, for glossary matching.

time_semantics.description: Not optional. A metric that does not pin these down is not finished.

reads_entities.description: Validator: each entity exists and carries each listed property.

gated_by.description: Every decision that affects this metric in any way: selecting a variant, changing a computation, the population, or a label. How it affects the metric is recorded on the decision's `gates` entry, not here. Validator: each exists (warning if enumerated but unwritten); every decision named in a variant's selected_when appears here; and gated_by is symmetric with decisions' `gates` — a decision gates this metric if and only if it is listed here.

consumes.description: ADR-0005. Upstream metrics this one reads, always qualified by variant; a bare metric id is a schema error. Empty only if nothing upstream.

variants.description: Any number of a metric's variants may be selected at once (mrr-usage-floor applies on top of the revenue-basis variant). Selection is never computed; it follows from the binding's answers. Validator: variant ids are unique, start with `<metric id>-`, and every non-draft variant is reachable by some combination of answers.

decomposable_by.description: Dimensions the metric can legitimately be split by.

relations.description: Metric-to-metric relations. What a metric reads from entities belongs in reads_entities, not here. The one exception is `contrastWith` a `concept` outside the ontology, written as free text, for a common confusion with something this ontology deliberately does not model (recognized revenue, ADR-0001). Validator: a `target` is an existing metric or Tier 2 component (warning if enumerated but unwritten).

components.description: Tier 2 stubs belonging to this metric. No variant tree, no own file.

benchmarks.description: Sourced or omitted. An unsourced range will be quoted.

consumption.description: `variant` is one variant id, a set of variant ids, or `selected` for whatever set the binding selected for that metric. Nothing restricts a metric to one variant at a time. Validator: every named variant belongs to the named metric.

selected_when.description: `always` for a variant no decision selects — it applies under every binding. Otherwise a condition on an earlier answer. Absent only on a draft variant, where it means not yet reachable.

benchmark.description: Shape provisional: no fixture carries a benchmark yet. The source is the only hard requirement.
